summary: Antonelli hunts his maiden world championship at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, where illness forces him to skip media day but not the fight for the crown. The high-altitude circuit's thin air and abrasive asphalt will test tire management and engine performance, creating an unpredictable midfield battle that could shuffle championship points in unexpected directions. Victory here would seal Antonelli's coronation as the sport's newest world champion, cementing one of the most dominant seasons in recent memory.
